nom: SKINN Dermappeal® Daily Moisturizing Face Scrub - Gentle Exfoliator

segments.sensitive: Most sensitive-skin reviewers, including some with rosacea, report they can use this daily without redness or irritation and describe it as gentle; one reviewer without a stated sensitivity found the texture and scent left her skin feeling a little sensitive during use.
segments.combination: A reviewer with combination skin, oily on her forehead and nose, reports the scrub remarkably reduced oiliness in those areas and reduced the look of her enlarged pores.
segments.oily: The same reviewer with oily patches on her forehead and nose reports the scrub remarkably reduced oiliness in those specific areas.
segments.mature: The one reviewer who states her age, 68, reports smoother, softer-looking skin after two weeks of use, along with better makeup application.

concerns.aging: One detailed reviewer credits the scrub with smoothing the look of wrinkles and fading dark spots, and a 68-year-old reviewer reports smoother, softer skin after two weeks; this is not corroborated in detail by other reviewers.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers report the scrub cleanses and exfoliates without the drying-out effect they experience with most other scrubs; one reviewer, however, says it cleanses gently but doesn't exfoliate or brighten her skin at all.
concerns.redness: One reviewer noticed temporary reddish patches where she scrubbed more vigorously, which faded within a few hours and did not recur once she used a lighter touch; another with sensitive skin reports no redness or irritation from first use.
concerns.barrier: Most reviewers, including several with sensitive skin or rosacea, report no irritation and describe the scrub as gentle enough for daily use; one reviewer without a stated sensitivity found the coarse texture and strong scent left her skin feeling a little sensitive during use.
concerns.spots: One detailed reviewer reports the scrub fades dark spots as part of an overall brightening effect; this is not corroborated in detail by other reviewers.
concerns.oiliness: A reviewer with combination skin reports the scrub remarkably reduced oiliness on her forehead and nose.

aspects.libelle: Very small bottle for the price
Mild scent, not overpowering for most users
Gritty but not overly abrasive texture
Small amount needed despite small bottle size
Considered pricey for how often it's used
Leaves skin smooth and soft immediately

extraits.texte: It clenses without drying out my skin. However, it doesn't really exfoliating or brighten my skin at all.

I am a big fan of ZO Skin Health products and they have a microdermabrasion product that I love. I was on the search for a dupe due to the price of the ZO product and found a few websites listing this due to its similar ingredients so I gave it a try. I found the texture of this product far more coarse than that of the ZO product and there is a very strong scent which I found a bit irritating to my skin. I don't have the most sensitive skin but with the coarse abrasion and strong scents, I found my skin feeling a little sensitive during use. After use however, my skin did feel quite smooth and clarified but I felt other products more than usual. As it is only 1oz, I did notice that I was running quite low after only a few weeks, while use maybe 2 times per week.

extraits.titre: Brightens, Smooths, Reduces Pore Size for my Sensitive Skin
extraits.texte: I use the regular Dermappeal by Skinn one to two times a week, and love it for exfoliating my sensitive skin, and wanted to try this product to use daily. I don't like trying products that don't have a full ingredient list displayed in their description, however, I was able to find it on Skinn's website and posted a photo of it. I react to almost everything, but this product made my skin so soft and smooth, and reduced the appearance of my enlarged pores. I have combination skin with really oily skin on my forehead and nose, and this product remarkably helped reduce the oil in those areas. It doesn't have a strong scent which I really appreciate. I think that it makes a difference for me and makes my skin look better. I still like the original Dermappeal better, but this is great for using on the days I don't use Dermappeal.

extraits.titre: This made a positive impact on my facial complexion after just one use.
extraits.texte: This facial exfoliation by SKINN worked amazingly well on my first use. To begin, after a few hours, I noticed that the skin on my nose, which tends to show pores, looked smooth, tight and healthier. My facial complexion also looked healthier, and clean, and radiant. This surprised me, since my complexion actually improved during the day. This exfoliation is meant to be applied prior to using a facial cleanser. I used a dime sized portion, and scrubbed my face, forehead and neck. One interesting note; After getting out of the shower, I looked at my facial complexion, and noticed some reddish patches where I had more vigorously scrubbed this exfoliator. They remained for 30 mins after I applied a facial moisturizer. A few hours later, there was no sign of redness. So key here is to not scrub to hard. Be gentle when applying this product. I have tried so many different facial scrubs, and nothing compares to this product in terms of instant impact. It’s really noticeable. I can’t wait to see what happens on my second use! Thank you for reading this honest review.

I love this face scrub. It is creamy and moisturizing but yet it had very gentle exfoliating texture. I can use this every day without bothering my skin and sometimes my skin can be sensitive because of my rosacea. I also like the smell it has a very mild clean smell. I like the feel of my skin after waking with this it is smooth and moisturized. The price is a little more than I like to spend but I would probably get it again because I really enjoy it.

I love this product! After two weeks of using, it I started to get compliments on my makeup. My skin looks and feels smoother and softer, and my makeup goes on so much better. Thats saying something because I'm 68.

extraits.titre: Unleash Your Inner Glow: SKINN Skin Care Dermappeal Review
extraits.texte: SKINN Skin Care Dermappeal is a total game-changer in my skincare routine! Imagine having the power of a professional microdermabrasion treatment right at your fingertips, in the comfort of your own home. That's exactly what Dermappeal delivers. It's like magic in a bottle—it smooths away wrinkles, banishes dry and dead skin cells, and even fades those pesky dark spots. But here's the best part: it's not just effective, it's also a luxurious experience. The scent is absolutely divine, like a refreshing trip to the spa every time I use it. And let me tell you, the results are beyond impressive. My skin has never looked or felt better since I started using Dermappeal. Sure, it's an investment, but trust me when I say it's worth every single penny. The confidence boost alone is priceless. If you're tired of dull, lackluster skin and ready to unleash your inner glow, SKINN Skin Care Dermappeal is the answer you've been searching for. Trust me, you'll wonder how you ever lived without it.
